$comment: Regression fixture for issue #65. Simulates a site.standard.document field that no pinned Lexicon declares yet -- a stand-in for whatever Standard.site adds next. Deliberately lives under fixtures/regression/ rather than fixtures/ directly: tools/lexicons/update-standard-site.mjs's listFixtureFiles() only reads the top level of fixtures/, so this file is invisible to (and never expected to pass) the schema-conformance check -- by construction, no pinned schema will ever declare futureField. Both platforms' decode-edit-encode round trip must still leave it and $comment untouched.
title: A document from a future Standard.site schema revision
futureField: This value must survive an edit round-trip even though no client models it yet.
